title: Gaussian quadrant probability at a threshold
statement: For a real correlation parameter $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$ and a real threshold $t$, define the Gaussian quadrant probability at threshold $t$ to be the probability, for a positively correlated standard Gaussian pair with correlation parameter $\rho$, that both coordinates lie in the open upper tail above $t$.
caveat: The supplied context does not define the positive-correlation construction or the open upper-tail event.
